description:
List the credentials this session has captured, by handle. Values are never shown.
PURPOSE: Find the name to pass to http_request({ auth: { secret } }), and see at a glance which entries have expired.
WHAT YOU GET: handle, kind, the origin it was seen on, age, and JWT expiry where the token carries one. Nothing derived from the token's claims — a JWT's issuer and subject are self-asserted, so they are not reported.
LIMITATIONS: memory only. A server restart empties the vault, and a handle from an older transcript resolves to nothing.
GOOD: list_secrets() -> http_request({ url: "https://api.acme.io/v1/me", method: "GET", auth: { secret: "api.acme.io" } })
name: list_secrets
